question: Which of the following elements is the most reactive?
solution:
The correct answer is '**__Calcium__'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Calcium (Ca)** is the most reactive metal amongst these.
 
• An element's **reactivity decreases while going down the reactivity series**.
 
• Reactivity of metals: **K > Na > Ca > Mg > Al > Zn > Fe > Pb > Cu**
 
• **Gold, silver and copper are the least reactive metals** and they are also known as** noble metals.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Reactivity series:**

 
 
• The reactivity series is a list of metals arranged in descending order of their activities.
 
• Because** they are easily oxidized**, the metals near the top of the reactivity range are powerful reducing agents.
 
• These **metals discolor and corrode quickly**.
 
• The reactivity series data can be used to determine if a metal can displace another in a single displacement reaction.
